description.value: China Cup Buffet is one of Prince George's longest-standing Chinese-Canadian restaurants, operating at Parkwood Place Mall for 18 years under various names before settling as China Cup in 2002. The daily all-you-can-eat buffet rotates over 30 hot dishes spanning Chinese classics and Canadian staples, plus sushi, a salad bar, and desserts. Dine-in, takeout, and free local delivery make it a flexible stop for hungry cyclists passing through the Cariboo region's largest city.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website at chinacupbuffet.ca confirms this is China Cup Buffet, a Chinese-Canadian all-you-can-eat buffet restaurant at #146 – 1600 15th Avenue, Prince George, BC (Parkwood Place Mall). The website explicitly confirms takeout and gluten-free options, as well as a broad vegetarian selection (veggie chow mein, vegetable fried rice, braised tofu, etc.). No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging appears anywhere on the site; OSM unit tag 'F121' conflicts with the website's '#146'.
concerns: OSM addr:unit is 'F121' but the business website consistently lists the unit as '#146'. The correct unit appears to be #146 based on the authoritative website source.
OSM record has no phone number; website lists two numbers (250-614-2323 and 250-614-8383). Primary number used in phone field.
OSM address lacks city and province; full address sourced from website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant in Prince George with an active website and confirmed current address. A practical full-service meal stop for touring cyclists in the Cariboo.

Takeout.detail: Website explicitly offers 'Take Out or Dine In' throughout, plus free home delivery within Prince George with a $30 minimum order

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Gluten-free options available on request and labeled on menu (marked GF). Vegetarian dishes confirmed: Vegetable Chow Mein, Vegetable Lo Mein, Vegetable Fried Rice, Braised Tofu, Tempura Vegetables, Veggie Rolls, and more
